report_name: New 'PhonySpy 2026' Spyware Toolkit Circulating on Public Forums

attack_patterns.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
attack_patterns.description: The PhonySpy 2026 spyware installs itself persistently on the device to run automatically.

attack_patterns.name: Malicious File
attack_patterns.description: Users are tricked into running a malicious installer file for the PhonySpy 2026 spyware, often bundled with legitimate-looking utilities or pirated software.

attack_patterns.name: Input Capture
attack_patterns.description: PhonySpy 2026 is capable of capturing various user inputs, including keystrokes, screenshots, and audio from the microphone.

attack_patterns.name: Keylogging
attack_patterns.description: The spyware toolkit includes keylogging functionality to capture user keystrokes.

attack_patterns.name: Screen Capture
attack_patterns.description: PhonySpy 2026 has the capability to capture screenshots from the victim's device.

attack_patterns.name: Audio Capture
attack_patterns.description: The spyware can remotely activate the device's microphone for eavesdropping.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Collected data such as contacts, messages, and location data is sent back to the attacker's command-and-control server.

attack_patterns.name: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: The spyware uses standard HTTP/S for command and control communication to blend in with normal network traffic.

malware.name: PhonySpy 2026
malware.description: A dangerous spyware toolkit circulating on public forums, marketed as a free surveillance utility. It has extensive data-collection capabilities, including access to contacts, messages, location, and microphone activation, and is available in both compiled and source-code form.

infrastructure.name: PhonySpy 2026 C2 Server
infrastructure.description: Command-and-control server used by PhonySpy 2026 to receive instructions and exfiltrate stolen information from compromised devices.

indicators.name: PhonySpy 2026 Associated Filenames
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: PhonySpy 2026 Associated Filenames
id: 9c5b1a3d-e8f0-4b1a-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects files on disk with names suggested as hunting hints for the PhonySpy 2026 spyware toolkit.
references:
  - https://www.netsec.io/threat-intelligence/new-phonyspy-2026-monitoring-tool-sparks-global-spyware-alarm/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-24
tags:
  - attack.t1204.002
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\monitor.exe'
      - '\syshost.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the presence of files named 'monitor.exe' or 'syshost.exe', which are suggested as indicators for the PhonySpy 2026 spyware.

indicators.name: Suspicious Regsvr32 Execution with Silent and Install Flags
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Regsvr32 Execution with Silent and Install Flags
id: 7a39f81e-c6d0-4e8b-9f0a-b1c2d3e4f5a6
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of regsvr32.exe with /s and /i flags, which can be used to execute malicious scripts. This pattern was suggested as a hunting hint for PhonySpy 2026.
references:
  - https://www.netsec.io/threat-intelligence/new-phonyspy-2026-monitoring-tool-sparks-global-spyware-alarm/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-24
tags:
  - attack.t1218.010
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\regsvr32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - ' /s'
      - ' /i'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of regsvr32.exe with /s and /i flags, a pattern suggested for hunting PhonySpy 2026, which is often used for malicious script execution.
